title: OutcomeRunFacet
description: An OpenLineage run facet carrying an agent run's outcome, the scorer that decided it, and whether that scorer's verdict may be cited. Two facts the standard has no field for.

resolved.description: The outcome, or null when no label has been attached.

authority.description: Whether the label may be cited, independent of its modality.

degraded.description: True when the scoring instrument was not working and returned its fail-open default.

joules.description: Physical energy, kept apart from tokens and elapsed time because each prices a different thing.

sourceRunId.description: The producer's own run id. The event's runId is this when it is a UUID and a uuid5 derived from it otherwise.
